facts.quote: Another tactic that’s worked well for Fly by Jing as part of its community-building strategy, according to Patricio-Archer, is partnering with other brands.

By the time Fly By Jing pursued retail partnerships with Whole Foods, Target, and eventually broader grocery distribution, the brand had something most emerging CPG products don’t: pre-existing demand signals.
For this week’s Modern Retail Talk, founder and CEO Jing Gao spoke about her trials and tribulations during the coronavirus.

parsed.subject: Collaborating on an Instagram Post for Fly By Jing
parsed.body:
Hi Fly By Jing team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your community-building strategy, as you’ve learned from Patricio-Archer and the insights from your sources. Your team has identified that partnering with other brands is a successful tactic for Fly By Jing, and that this approach is a key component of your marketing efforts. This post would be a great opportunity to showcase your partnership and further engage your audience through a shared Instagram experience. It would be a chance to explore how you can bring your unique brand story to a wider audience, and it would be a fantastic way to continue building on the momentum you’ve already achieved.

The BrandPilot team.
